By Trenton Journal
●
Business
●
August 20, 2026
Mayor W. Reed Gusciora visited the Hibbert Group this week to celebrate the company’s 145th anniversary and tour its longtime Trenton headquarters, recognizing one of the Capital City’s oldest private companies and its evolution from a local printing business into a national provider of marketing, technology, fulfillment and logistics services.
